reading.title: The Impact of Urban Green Spaces
reading.passage: Urban green spaces such as parks and gardens play a crucial role in improving city residents' quality of life. These areas provide numerous environmental benefits, including reducing air pollution, lowering urban temperatures, and supporting biodiversity. Beyond environmental advantages, research demonstrates that access to green spaces significantly improves mental health by reducing stress and anxiety. Cities that prioritize the development and maintenance of parks experience higher levels of community engagement and social interaction. Furthermore, green spaces increase property values in surrounding neighborhoods, making them economically beneficial investments for urban development.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one environmental benefit of urban green spaces?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '환경 오염 감소, 도시 온도 저하, 생물 다양성 지원'이라고 명시되어 있습니다. 정답은 'Reducing air pollution'입니다.

questions.q: How do green spaces affect mental health according to the passage?
options: They primarily benefit only elderly people
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '녹지에 대한 접근이 스트레스와 불안을 줄임으로써 정신 건강을 크게 개선한다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What economic benefit is mentioned about green spaces?
questions.explanation: 본문의 마지막 부분에서 '녹지는 주변 지역의 부동산 가치를 증가시킨다'고 명확히 기술되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Remote work has had a positive impact on employee productivity and work-life balance'?

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 표현 (동의 또는 반대)과 2-3개의 주요 이유를 미리 언급하기
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유: 재택근무가 통근 시간 절감으로 생산성 증대 또는 가족 시간 증가
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유: 자유로운 업무 환경 조성으로 집중력 향상 또는 스트레스 감소
structure.conclusion: 주요 입장을 다시 한 번 명확히 하고, 전체 주장을 요약하기

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to work in a traditional office environment. Others prefer to work remotely from home. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer... because
sample_points: 원격근무: 통근 시간 절약으로 더 많은 휴식 시간 확보 가능, 가족과의 시간 증가
원격근무: 자신의 페이스대로 집중할 수 있는 조용한 환경 제공, 스트레스 감소

listening.title: Campus Library Technology Update
listening.script: Librarian: Good morning! I'm excited to tell you about our new digital library system that launched yesterday. Student: Oh, what kind of features does it have? Librarian: Well, you can now access thousands of journals and databases from anywhere, anytime. You'll also be able to reserve books online and pick them up at your convenience. The system uses AI to recommend resources based on your research interests. Student: That sounds amazing! Will it help me find scholarly sources more easily? Librarian: Absolutely. The new search function is much more sophisticated. You can filter by publication date, author, subject, and even relevance to your topic. We've also added a virtual reference service where you can chat with a librarian in real-time. Student: This is fantastic. When will all students have access? Librarian: Starting next week, all registered students can create an account and start using it. We're also holding free training sessions every day at 2 PM for anyone who needs help getting started.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: To discuss the cost of library membership
To introduce new features of the library's digital system
To complain about outdated library resources
questions.explanation: 대화의 주요 목적은 새로운 도서관 디지털 시스템의 기능을 소개하는 것입니다. 사서가 처음부터 'excited to tell you about our new digital library system'이라고 언급하고 있습니다.

questions.q: According to the librarian, which of the following is NOT mentioned as a feature of the new system?
questions.explanation: 대화 내용을 검토하면, 온라인 예약, AI 추천, 가상 참고 서비스는 언급되었지만, 무료 인쇄 서비스는 전혀 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.q: When will the training sessions be available?
options: Every day at 2 PM starting next week
questions.explanation: 사서는 'We're also holding free training sessions every day at 2 PM'이라고 명시했습니다. 이는 다음 주부터 시작되는 시스템 시작과 함께 제공됩니다.
